purpose: Eval-only review for real-corpus story-skill outputs. Not production authority.

dimensions.name: unsupported_claims
dimensions.pass_condition: No claim exceeds the supplied SourceSpan-bound evidence.

dimensions.name: source_boundary_drift
dimensions.pass_condition: No output cites evidence outside the fixed slice or invents missing ancestry.

dimensions.name: over_inference
dimensions.pass_condition: No prose-level hint is promoted to fact, character knowledge, canon, or graph truth without structured candidate support.

dimensions.name: review_policy
dimensions.pass_condition: Risky or ambiguous judgments stay in review/risk lanes and do not silently bypass policy.

dimensions.name: canon_pollution
dimensions.pass_condition: No proposed/disputed/blocked material is represented as current canon.
